== English Reflections II comparison ==
The Reflections II original prints deploy 2. The photographed Reflections III foil prints deploy 7. Decipher's January 2002 correction applies to the misprinted foil and restores deploy 2. Printed game text, icons and other statistics agree across the original and foil. Existing routes continue to select the original or its documentary correction article.
